what: When the element enters 10% above the bottom of the screen, a mask (a solid panel + an 8×8 Bayer gradient as long as the child text width) slides in from the left, and the big numerals sweep out, spreading from sparse dots to dense dots (.8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) · .25s delay · dot 3px, phone 2px). Once fully swept, the mask is removed

options.dot: Dot size (px), default 3 — dot-sm applies below 767px, default 2

from.where: index.html .sh-capital__figure (original capital-reveal: rootMargin 0 0 −10% 0, --dither-dot-size 3px/2px, child width ÷ dot = Bakes a slanted SVG by cell count and animates mask-position (left − 2×band)→left, --duration-reveal .8s · --easing-in-out · --reveal-delay .25s, and removes the mask when finished)
